name: Hepatitis
overview: Hepatitis is a health condition that requires individualized medical assessment. Symptoms, causes, and treatment vary by person — consult a qualified doctor in India for diagnosis and a care plan tailored to your history and local guidelines.
symptoms: From a clinical perspective, hepatitis is inflammation of the liver tissue.
From a clinical perspective, hepatitis is acute if it resolves within six months, and chronic if it lasts longer than six months.
From a clinical perspective, acute hepatitis can resolve on its own, progress to chronic hepatitis, or (rarely) result in acute liver failure.
From a clinical perspective, chronic hepatitis may progress to scarring of the liver (cirrhosis), liver failure, and liver cancer.

faq.question: Can I rely on this Hepatitis information instead of a doctor visit?
faq.answer: No. This content supports learning and preparation for conversations with qualified healthcare professionals. It is not a substitute for diagnosis or treatment.

faq.question: What should I do if Hepatitis symptoms worsen suddenly?
faq.answer: Seek urgent medical care, especially if severe pain, breathing difficulty, confusion, or high fever develops.
